reply: Best candidate reached NMSE 2.7e-12: sigma ≈ 1.448 + 0.0728·ln T − 0.330/T − 4.521·T − 0.0314·T² + 1.281·T·ln T + 0.533·eps^1.5, with T in units of 100 K and eps in percent. The eps^1.5 term is clear, but the temperature part is an empirical fit, so I can't confirm it is the exact closed form.
